tldr: Moon in the 12th house routes emotional safety through the hidden inner life.
body: With the Moon in the 12th house, emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety move through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, dreams, release, and spiritual repair. This makes how you meet what is private, unconscious, unfinished, or ready to be released a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs. Left unconscious, it can become mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and the ability to nurture what this house governs expressed through the hidden inner life.
challenge: mood-driven choices, over-attachment, defensiveness, or letting old emotional patterns run this area concentrated in the hidden inner life.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
